jobs.title: Marketing Tracking & Data Solutions Specialist- Entain
Backend Tech Lead
jobs.description: Are you ready to take on a dynamic leadership role where you'll shape the future of a high-scale, tech-driven product? At 365Scores, we’re looking for a passionate Tech Lead to join our collaborative team. You’ll be at the forefront of innovation—designing scalable solutions, guiding architecture, and driving technical excellence as we deliver world-class experiences to millions of sports fans around the globe. Design robust APIs and services for a vast user base Architect and guide performance optimization, security, and scalability strategies Analyze and process large datasets in near real-time to deliver insight Oversee data pipelines that power real-time push notifications for a global user base Provide a technical specification for complicated features Support development team, delegate tasks, and resolve technical blockers Perform code reviews to ensure best practices are followed and offer constructive feedback for continuous improvement. Ensure high code quality, maintainability, and test coverage (unit/integration tests) Own the delivery of releases all the way to production Help manage hiring process and onboarding of developers At least 10 years of proven experience in: .NET Core, C#, Web API, and Entity Framework Core Experience with multithreading, caching mechanisms and message queue systems Object-oriented programming, design patterns and principles Designing and developing multithreaded and asynchronous applications Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized deployments Cloud platforms (AWS preferred, Azure acceptable) and microservices architecture Message queues and distributed application design RDBMS (MS SQL Server), ADO.NET, database design, and TSQL including complex Stored Procedures and query optimization, MongoDB Excellent English communication skills Great teamwork skills, with the ability to work remotely and assume responsibility independently Desirable: FrontEnd development skills Experience with Kubernetes

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: At 365Scores, we're revolutionizing how fans receive and interact with live sports updates and data. Our platform combines the intensity of live sports with cutting-edge technology to deliver a personalized experience to millions of users worldwide. As a Senior Data Scientist at 365Scores, you will be an integral part of our Machine Learning and AI team. The role is hands-on and impact-driven, focusing on building, improving, and delivering machine learning models that directly support business goals. Design and deploy production ML systems that drive automated business decisions (pricing, bidding, resource allocation) Build end-to-end ML pipelines — from data ingestion and model training to serving, monitoring, and incident response Translate ambiguous business problems into rigorous mathematical frameworks and own them from conception to production impact Conduct rigorous experimentation (A/B testing, causal inference, uplift modeling) to measure and improve model performance Maintain and improve real-time models that adapt to incoming data and feedback signals Mentor junior team members on ML best practices and production standards 5+ years in ML roles with demonstrated production impact Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a quantitative field, or equivalent industry depth Deep expertise in mathematical optimization — convex, constrained, and gradient-based methods Hands-on experience with Bayesian or hyperparameter optimization Strong causal inference skills — propensity scoring, uplift modeling, or experimental design Applied ML experience in optimization domains: pricing, bidding, or resource allocation Advanced time series modeling for dynamic, decision-making systems Proven experience deploying and monitoring real-time ML models in production Familiarity with experiment tracking, model versioning, and performance monitoring

jobs.title: Growth Product Builder – Performance Marketing
jobs.description: Entain is looking for a hands-on, execution-focused Growth Product Builder to take complete operational ownership of creating and optimizing landing pages for our global performance marketing channels. In this role, you will be the direct engine behind the gateways handling hundreds of millions of dollars in marketing spend across premier brands like bwin, Ladbrokes, Coral, and PartyPoker. This is not a traditional, hands-off management role. You will be a hybrid builder, someone who started in frontend web development (HTML, CSS, JS) and has a sharp eye for conversion rate optimization (CRO) and design. You will work directly with performance marketing stakeholders, brand managers, and design teams to take brief requirements and personally build, code, and launch innovative landing pages directly inside our Sitecore CMS framework. By aggressively utilizing cutting-edge AI generation tools, you will act as a force multiplier—rapidly executing layouts, copy variations, and functional tests on your own without waiting for central development queues. End-to-End Page Creation: Take a campaign brief from marketing or a concept from design and personally build, format, and publish the landing pages directly inside the CMS. You are the solo owner of the execution phase. AI-Powered Assembly & Coding: Actively use modern AI tools to generate high-performing frontend code, write clean copy variations, and assemble layouts at lightning speed. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with Performance Marketing teams to understand campaign goals, and with Brand/Design teams to ensure every page is visually stunning and strictly compliant, all while optimizing for maximum conversion drop-offs. Hands-on Front-End Customization: Know exactly when to build modularly using design system components for speed, inject raw optimized HTML/CSS for quick validation, or configure interactive elements for deeper user engagement[cite: 1, 2]. A/B Testing Implementation: Personally set up, deploy, and monitor multivariate tests down the funnel to continuously lift registration and first-time deposit metrics. The Technical Foundation: Strong background in core frontend development (HTML5, CSS3, vanilla JavaScript). You must be completely comfortable looking at, writing, and debugging web code. The Growth Shift: Experience in a Growth, CRO, or digital production role where your success was measured by hard conversion metrics (CVR, CTR), not just task completion. CMS Execution: Direct experience authoring, structuring, and launching digital assets within enterprise CMS platforms (Sitecore experience is highly advantageous)[cite: 1, 2]. AI Tool Pro: Mastery of prompt engineering and AI development workflows to accelerate layout generation and asset production. Speed & Autonomy: An entrepreneurial mindset. You thrive on being the single bottleneck-remover who can turn an idea into a live, multi-geo web asset in the same day. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Funnel Conversion Rate (CVR) Lift: Measurable growth in user registration and first-time deposits down the acquisition funnel. Production Velocity: Drastic reduction in time-to-market from creative handoff to a live, compliant, public-facing URL. Autonomy Rate: Ability to deliver complex, high-converting layouts independently without relying on core engineering sprint cycles.

jobs.title: Marketing Tracking & Data Solutions Specialist- Entain
jobs.description: Entain is looking for a hands-on, execution-focused Growth Product Builder to take complete operational ownership of creating and optimizing landing pages for our global performance marketing channels. In this role, you will be the direct engine behind the gateways handling hundreds of millions of dollars in marketing spend across premier brands like bwin, Ladbrokes, Coral, and PartyPoker. The Marketing Tracking & Data Solutions Specialist serves as the technical foundation for our performance marketing operations. This role ensures that every pixel, tag, and API signal functions correctly across multiple global brands, websites, and applications. As a hands-on individual contributor, you will act as the primary technical expert for the marketing department when data discrepancies or tracking failures occur (e.g., missing conversions, Meta Ads signal drops, or AppsFlyer event mismatches). This position requires a proactive professional who uses SQL and data warehouse environments to identify and resolve anomalies before they impact reporting. This is a dedicated technical specialist role focused entirely on deep ownership of data infrastructure and troubleshooting, without people-management responsibilities. Production Support & Troubleshooting Own the end-to-end resolution of tracking and signal-delivery incidents (detection, root cause analysis, remediation, and documentation). Diagnose data discrepancies across three distinct delivery paths: client-side GTM tags, Server-to-Platform CAPI, and reverse ETL. Address and resolve brand- or country-specific tracking constraints, including regulatory and consent requirements. Data Quality & Analysis Conduct regular audits of event and conversion data across major platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, AppsFlyer, TikTok, and programmatic partners) to prevent attribution distortions. Utilize SQL within Snowflake to validate that events sent via CAPI and reverse ETL match system specifications. Document technical incidents and resolutions in clear, actionable reports for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. AppsFlyer & GTM Ownership Manage configurations and serve as the primary subject-matter expert for AppsFlyer and Google Tag Manager (both client-side and server-side) across all brands. Partner with the internal GA4 team on cross-functional data issues (without holding direct responsibility for GA4 configuration). Experience: 2–4+ years of hands-on experience with marketing tracking/tagging (GTM) and implementation of CAPI or server-side solutions. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in SQL, with experience querying and validating data within a data warehouse environment (Snowflake preferred). Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of client-side vs. server-side/API event delivery, mobile measurement platforms (AppsFlyer or equivalent), and the conversion mechanics of Google Ads and Meta Ads. Problem Solving: Proven ability to diagnose production data issues systematically using data analysis rather than trial and error. Communication: Ability to explain complex technical data issues clearly to business stakeholders and collaborate effectively with development teams. Nice to Have- Familiarity with GA4 event architecture. Experience with reverse ETL tools (e.g., Fivetran) and Consent Management Platforms (CMPs). Background in e-commerce, gaming, or betting industries. Familiarity with project tracking tools such as Monday.com.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: 365Scores isn’t just an app; it’s the digital pulse of sports fans worldwide. We are looking for a talented, data-driven Product Manager who lives at the intersection of sports, technology, and user experience. You aren't just writing specs; you’re building the user experience for millions of sport fans. If you can translate complex sports data into a seamless user journey, we might have a fit. End-to-End Ownership: lead the full product lifecycle from initial idea and detailed PRDs to version release and post-launch optimization. Cross-Functional Coaching: Collaborate with Design, Dev, BI, and Content teams to turn ideas into high-performing features. You will be the focal point that keeps the team aligned. Data-Driven Growth: utilize user data to define product KPIS and make sure those KPIs are achieved. Execution Excellence: take full responsibility for the product from start to the "Finish Line" to ensure we ship the best possible version of the product on time. 3+ years of hands-on PM experience managing mobile/web products with rich interfaces and complex real-time data flows. Pro in writing clear specifications, building wireframes, and conducting market research independently. A "Go-Getter" who thrives in autonomy. You don't wait for instructions—you identify priorities and execute. Strong organizational and analytical skills, excellent written and oral communication skills Agility, ability to pivot quickly. In our world, the "score" changes fast, and you need to think on your feet to hit tight deadlines. AI knowledge, "AI-first" builder who uses generative tools to streamline your ideas into product specifications.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description: 365Scores is a global sports technology hub that offers multiple solutions to dozens of millions of users worldwide. The company provides real-time results, updated stats, original content, aggregated information, customized news feeds, and more. Our products are based on cutting-edge technologies that enable live updates and on-demand content libraries of the highest quality and scale. 365scores is seeking a Senior Data Analyst position to join the BI Team, with a passion for technology, to solve unique problems within our measurements. Our team solves many challenges in turning raw data into accurate signals and extracting insights to improve the 365Scores products. Appropriate candidates have an understanding of multiple components across the big data stack: large-scale data analysis, data quality, statistics, and visualization. If you are the kind of researcher who's focused on results and a quick learner, this role is for you. This position is located in our Tel Aviv office. Function as the data authority in the Monetization domain - performing ad-hoc research and analysis on the company's rich data to support unique and strategic business questions. Define, analyze, and monitor KPIs and OKR metrics to continually improve company products. Analyze large, complex data sets to address strategic and operational business questions. Actively take part in building and maintaining our “AI Driven-BI” Agentic Architecture. Build dashboards and visualizations to answer key questions for the company's in-house various teams, specifically for the Monetization Team. Perform qualitative, quantitative, and statistical analysis. True passion for understanding data and finding Insights. Provide actionable recommendations and conclusions from data to shape features and future product road maps. At least 3 years experience in data analysis, preferably in a complex business environment. Experience with User Behavior analysis methods and models: Segmentation, Retention, Ad optimization, User activity funnels, etc. Strong SQL skills with experience in querying large, complex data sets in with Cloud Data Warehouses (Redshift, Big Query, or Snowflake) Experience working with BI tools for data visualization (Preferably Looker). A strong foundation in statistical methods and data modeling. BA / BSc in Industrial Engineering and Management / Information Systems Engineering / Economics / Statistics / similar background. Quick learner, proactive/can-do attitude with high attention to detail. A strong sense of ownership, leading data initiatives from end to end independently. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Creative and critical thinking skills. A team player with strong analytical and problem-solving skills as well as a business sense. Excellent communication skills with fluent English (written and verbal); Strong "story-teller" that can communicate insights and recommendations effectively. Advantages Previous experience as a Monetization or Product Analyst / Close collaboration with similar teams - a big advantage. Hands-on experience with AI Tools and methodologies: Cursor, Claude Code, Context Engineering, NLQ, etc. Knowledge of Python for data prep, analysis and statistical modelling - a big advantage. Hands-on practical knowledge in A/B testing to facilitate data-driven decision-making processes. Knowledge of statistics and experience using statistical packages for analyzing datasets Experience in a B2C tech company. Passion for Sport.

jobs.title: User Acquisition Manager
jobs.description: 365Scores is one of the world's leading sports apps, serving millions of passionate sports fans across the globe with real-time scores, news, personalized updates, and engaging content. We are looking for a highly analytical and performance-driven User Acquisition Manager to join our team and help scale our global user growth efforts. In this role, you will own acquisition and re-engagement activities across multiple paid media channels, optimize campaigns at scale, and drive measurable impact on user growth and business performance. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines strong performance marketing expertise with a passion for data, experimentation, AI-driven innovation, and mobile app growth. Own and manage user acquisition, re-engagement, and retention campaigns across multiple advertising channels, including Meta, Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, DSPs, OEMs, and ad networks. Monitor, analyze, and optimize campaigns to achieve and exceed growth KPIs, including installs, registrations, retention, engagement, and revenue targets. Plan, execute, and scale innovative growth initiatives, experiments, and A/B tests to improve acquisition efficiency and user quality. Build and maintain strategic relationships with media partners, advertising platforms, and agencies. Provide regular performance reporting, insights, and recommendations to internal stakeholders and external partners. Collaborate closely with Product, Content, Data, and Business Development teams to align marketing activities with product launches, sports calendars, and engagement initiatives. Work with the creative team to continuously test new ad creatives, messaging, and formats across different markets and audiences. Analyze user behavior, attribution data, cohort performance, and conversion funnels to identify growth opportunities. Support expansion into new markets through competitive analysis, market research, and audience insights. Stay updated on industry trends, privacy changes, attribution solutions, mobile measurement, and best practices across performance marketing channels. 4+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns, with a strong focus on PPC (Search, Display, YouTube) and App Campaigns (UAC) for mobile app growth. 2+ years of experience managing Meta Ads campaigns focused on performance marketing and user acquisition. Strong passion for AI tools and emerging technologies, with hands-on usage of AI solutions for creative production, workflow automation, campaign optimization, research, and productivity enhancement. Proven experience driving mobile app growth through user acquisition, re-engagement, and performance marketing initiatives. Strong understanding of mobile marketing KPIs, including CPI, CPA, CAC, ROAS, retention, engagement, and LTV. Highly analytical with strong problem-solving skills and exceptional attention to detail. Experience working with mobile attribution and analytics platforms such as AppsFlyer, Firebase, Adjust, or similar tools. Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Content, Creative, BI, and Business Development teams. Ability to prioritize multiple projects and work effectively in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment. Fluent English, both written and spoken. Advantages- Experience working in a startup environment, or a strong passion for operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial, hands-on growth culture. Experience with additional acquisition channels such as TikTok Ads, Apple Search Ads, DSPs, OEMs, or other mobile advertising platforms. Experience in sports, media, betting, gaming, or other consumer mobile app industries. Passion for sports and familiarity with major sports leagues, competitions, and events.
